spec.name: Orange Kitchen Raw Patty
spec.description: A thick, hand-pressed minced beef patty with a rounded stepped perimeter, soft domed center, and connected folds of raw mince. Muted ivory fat marbling contrasts with fresh rosy beef. Ground bottom is y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Raw Patty. Recognizable prepared cooking ingredient. Flour/salt/grounds in a small open paper packet or bowl, liquids in a little bottle, dough soft and folded, meat textured and distinct. Pick the correct form for the item. Actual recipe ingredients: minced beef. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
